mapper.select: select id, name, short_name, region, world_rank, color1, color2, logo from es_team order by world_rank
select id, team_id, nick, real_name, country, rating, kd, adr, kast, maps_cnt from es_player order by rating desc

select t.id, t.name, t.region, date_format(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as start_date, date_format(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as end_date, (select count(*) from es_match m where m.tournament_id = t.id) as match_count from es_tournament t order by t.id

select m.id, m.tournament_id, t.name as tournament, m.stage, m.bo, m.status, m.team1_id, m.team2_id, date_format(m.start_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') as start_time, mm.id as m_id, mm.map_order as m_map_order, mm.map_name as m_map_name, mm.score1 as m_score1, mm.score2 as m_score2, mm.live as m_live from es_match m left join es_tournament t on m.tournament_id = t.id left join es_match_map mm on m.id = mm.match_id order by m.start_time

select m.id, m.tournament_id, m.stage, m.bo, m.team1_id, m.team2_id, m.status, m.start_time, mm.id as m_id, mm.map_order as m_map_order, mm.map_name as m_map_name, mm.score1 as m_score1, mm.score2 as m_score2, mm.live as m_live from es_match m inner join es_match_map mm on m.id = mm.match_id where m.status = 'finished' order by m.start_time, mm.map_order
mapper.insert: insert into es_team (name, short_name, region, world_rank, color1, color2) values (#{name}, #{shortName}, #{region}, #{worldRank}, #{color1}, #{color2})
mapper.select: select count(*) from es_match where team1_id = #{teamId} or team2_id = #{teamId}
mapper.insert: insert into es_match (tournament_id, stage, bo, team1_id, team2_id, status, start_time) values (#{tournamentId}, #{stage}, #{bo}, #{team1Id}, #{team2Id}, #{status}, #{startTime})
mapper.update: update es_match set tournament_id = #{tournamentId}, stage = #{stage}, bo = #{bo}, team1_id = #{team1Id}, team2_id = #{team2Id}, status = #{status}, start_time = #{startTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into es_match_map (match_id, map_order, map_name, score1, score2, live) values (#{matchId}, #{mapOrder}, #{name}, #{score1}, #{score2}, #{live})
insert into es_tournament (name, region, start_date, end_date) values (#{name}, #{region}, #{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select count(*) from es_tournament where name = #{name} and id != #{excludeId}
select count(*) from es_match where tournament_id = #{tournamentId}
mapper.insert: insert into es_player (team_id, nick, real_name, country, rating, kd, adr, kast, maps_cnt) values (#{teamId}, #{nick}, #{name}, #{country}, #{rating}, #{kd}, #{adr}, #{kast}, #{maps})
mapper.update: update es_player set team_id = #{teamId}, nick = #{nick}, real_name = #{name}, country = #{country}, rating = #{rating}, kd = #{kd}, adr = #{adr}, kast = #{kast}, maps_cnt = #{maps} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from es_team where id = #{id}
select count(*) from es_player where nick = #{nick} and id != #{excludeId}
mapper.delete: delete from es_tournament_progress where tournament_id = #{tournamentId} and team_id = #{teamId}
mapper.insert: insert into es_tournament_progress (tournament_id, team_id, result) values (#{tournamentId}, #{teamId}, #{result})
mapper.select: select p.tournament_id as tournamentId, p.team_id as teamId, p.result, t.name as teamName, t.short_name as shortName, t.logo, t.color1, t.color2, t.world_rank as worldRank from es_tournament_progress p left join es_team t on p.team_id = t.id where p.tournament_id = #{tournamentId} order by p.result, t.world_rank
